recovery_rule: A recovery may succeed only if exact_heldout_replay is the sole failed original check, all other original checks are true, all frozen/reproduced canonical hashes from the original verifier match, frozen_mismatches is empty, and the locked rubric is unchanged.
root_cause: Frozen verifier compared the in-memory replay result containing tuple-valued query traces directly to JSON-loaded frozen evidence where those tuples are lists. Canonical JSON serialization normalizes both to the same persisted representation; the frozen verifier itself already computed identical canonical hashes for all three seeds.
